# Lockers FAQ

Test data for the ingestion pipeline.

<!-- this HTML comment is stripped by the clean stage -->

## Renting

### How is a locker rented?

A locker is rented at the Security desk with a campus ID card. The rental lasts one semester.

## Returning

### When are lockers emptied?

Lockers are emptied in the week after final exams. Items left behind go to lost property.
